title: The Dream Atlas.docx
content: This is my ongoing attempt to document my dream world. I have been recording these recurring dreams since I was about five years old, slowly building what I now call The Dream Atlas. Over time, I have drawn, written, and mapped the places I have seen. Some reappear exactly as they were years ago, while others change each time I return. The project has become a kind of personal field study, an effort to understand how memory, imagination, and dreaming overlap. The map is still unfinished, and I update it whenever new details appear or old ones shift. I have shared earlier versions here before as my own art and also images both ai and real, but this is the first time I have begun collecting everything into a consistent written format.
